propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui ad tuendam catholicam fidem beatum Petrum Confessorem tuum
virtute et doctrina roborasti: concede propitius; ut, ejus exemplis et
monitis, errantes ad salutem resipiscant, et fideles in veritatis
confessione perseverent. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Leaf n983, printed p. 991, under `Prayer` in the Mass headed `St. Peter Canisius, Confessor and Doctor of the Church`. The Latin is the 1962 slot's prayer word for word, differing only in pointing. The page itself prints Peter's name, title and English, so nothing is supplied by this inventory.
translations.source_label: The New Roman Missal in Latin and English, revised edition, by F. X. Lasance and Francis Augustine Walsh (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1945), ca. 1955-56 printing (Internet Archive delivery locator fr-lasance-missal-1937; locator mislabelled)
translations.text: O God, Who for the defense of the Catholic Faith didst strengthen blessed Peter, Thy confessor, with virtue and learning: vouchsafe in Thy loving kindness, that by his example and precepts the erring may be restored to salvation, and the faithful may persevere in the confession of the truth. Through our Lord.

ordinary_disposition.basis: Printed after the Postcommunions as an alternative Epistle for Doctors.

propers.text:
Sancti N. Confessoris tui atque Doctoris nobis, Domine, pia non desit
oratio: quae et munera nostra conciliet; et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper
obtineat. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

The same one Secret on leaves n1365-n1366 prints `Pontificis (vel Confessoris)` and `bishop (or confessor)`.
